intent: Hold a Carousel's slides in the clipped viewport the carousel engine scrolls.
typical_uses: The one track inside a Carousel that holds its CarouselItem slides

dont_use_when.situation: A clipped scrolling container outside any Carousel

invariants.text: CarouselContent renders two nested divs: an outer viewport the engine attaches to, which clips overflow, and an inner flex track the engine moves. `className` and every forwarded prop land on the inner track, never on the outer viewport.

anti_patterns.dont: Put more than one CarouselContent in a Carousel
anti_patterns.do_instead: Use one CarouselContent per Carousel; the root owns a single engine instance with a single viewport ref, so only one track is driven

bad.title: A track with no Carousel around it
bad.why: CarouselContent reads the root's context through useCarousel and throws "useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />" when there is none.
